Container.Name: lantern
Container.Overview: 1Password family dead man's switch. n8n POSTs /run with the run token. GET / shows running.

Config.Name: Port
Config.Description: HTTP port. n8n: POST /run. Browser: GET / returns running.

Config.Name: Token
Config.Description: 1Password service account token. Grant Create vaults only.

Config.Name: Run token
Config.Description: Shared secret. n8n header: Authorization: Bearer <this value>

Config.Name: Vault title
Config.Description: Name of each person's live vault. Default Lantern.

Config.Name: Inactive after days
Config.Description: Days without a 1Password login before a trip. 7-365. Warns for the last 3 days.

Config.Name: Test day
Config.Description: Leave empty. Fakes idle days for every member. 87=warn, 90=trip. Clear when done.

Config.Name: Ping URL
Config.Description: Optional. Full URL to GET after a successful /run. Leave empty to skip.
